verdict.rationale: QuickBooks documents in-product AI insights via Intuit Intelligence chat—asking natural-language questions like 'What's driving my profit?' or 'How are my invoices doing?' and getting instant contextual answers, plus AI-generated reports (top expenses, sales trends, benchmarking), anomaly detection, and financials-based funding suggestions. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of insight quality and accuracy, and no evidence beyond first-party marketing docs.
